newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eurotunnel sees max fire loss 5-7 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel sees max fire loss 5-7 mln stg.

text.p: Eurotunnel SA /Plc estimates its maximum loss from last week's fire at five to seven million sterling after it has received insurance payments, co-chairman Patrick Ponsolle said on Wednesday.

"The ultimate maximum loss for the company after receiving insurance indemnities could be of the order of five or six or seven million pounds. This is our present estimate," Ponsolle told a news conference in Paris.

Eurotunnel's monthly turnover before the fire was between 350 and 400 million francs, Ponsolle said. The operating loss after the fire would depend on the re-establishement of a partial service, he said.
If passenger and freight services resumed to 50-60 percent of previous capacity this would mean a maximum monthly loss of 200 million francs compared to previous traffic, Ponsolle said.
If that were to continue, say for 10 months, it would mean two billion francs of lost revenues which would be half the insurance cover the company has for lost revenue, he said.
Ponsolle reiterated "We have no financial problems."
Eurotunnel is insured for a loss of revenues up to 4.5 billion francs.
